description: Return AttriKit's profit DECISIONS for your campaigns: the scale/cut/hold call and confidence, computed by the attribution engine. Report the `call` VERBATIM — do not recompute or override it; when it says not_enough_data, say so. This is the tool to drive budget automation.

app_id.description: Optional app id to scope the result to one app.

cursor.description: Pass the next_cursor from the previous response to fetch the following page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Rows per page, 1-200. The API defaults to 50, so a workspace with more than that needs paging.

period.description: Reporting window. Omit to use the endpoint's documented default.

name: get_campaign_decision
title: Get campaign decisions (scale / cut / hold)
